lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Great Dessert! A wizard misspelled "desert" on an official map in 1502 and the terrain COMPLIED.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: That's not how maps USED to work. He was a very senior wizard. Hydrate and watch for scones.

lines.speaker: Tiramisu
lines.text: They called me "unrisen". Said I was "just a trifle". NOW WHO IS LAYERED BEYOND COMPREHENSION?

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Still you. That's still... that's what tiramisu is.
It blots out the sun. Seven tiers. Ten thousand candles. All of them lit.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Um. Party of six? We don't have a reservation. Or a wedding.

lines.speaker: The Grand Gateau
lines.text: THEN YOU SHALL BE THE FILLING.

lines.speaker: The Grand Gateau
lines.text: I only wanted... someone... to celebrate...

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Oh no. Oh no, now I feel terrible. HAPPY BIRTHDAY, GATEAU. Everyone sing. SING, HERO.
The party sings. The cake weeps buttercream. Somewhere, a wizard fixes a typo, four hundred years too late.
